messages:
rachel: quick idea  tiny holiday postcard exchange? send a postcard (or photo of one) with a one-line note. we'll shuffle and mail/screenshot to match remote folks. low-effort, high-cheer. :postcard: :sparkles:

tom: love this. remote ok? i'm in seattle and would love a real postcard. :house_with_garden:

ana: remote +1. can we do 'mystery compliment' lines only? like 'you made my week because...' short & sweet.

zack: i'm in. can we set a signup deadline? and is postage on me or company covers if international? 

rachel: signup idea: Google form with name, address (optional), and 'photo OK instead of card' checkbox. deadline Wed 5pm. company will cover postage under $5/person 1. DM me for int'l postage and i'll coordinate.

mail-bot: Reminder created: "Holiday Postcard Shuffle" deadline Wed 17:00 (channel: #random).

tom: also tiny note: include a return-friendly name so recipient can send thanks if they want. no pressure.

ana: i'm doing a tiny watercolor card. who else is doing artsy stuff? :art: 

zack: i'll scribble a terrible comic. guaranteed chuckle. :laughing:

rachel: perfect. i'll post the signup link in 5 and then DM anyone who needs postage help. thanks y'all 1 :heart:
